newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices expected to be firm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices expected to be firm.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to continue to be firm at sales this week, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly market preview.
The eastern market indicator last week rose 16 cents to 584 cents a kg clean, while the western indicator rose 17 cents to 559 a kg clean.
Sales this week are in Sydney and Geelong with a total of 59,000 bales on offer.
Wesfarmers said that as anticipated, prices firmed considerably last week and the outlook suggested this would be sustained.
"This is mostly due to limited quantities available for sale throughout January putting buyers under pressure as they cover positions," Wesfarmers Dalgety said.
With quantities of broad wool particularly limited until the Adelaide sale in the final week of January, this end of the market was expected to show greatest strength, Wesfarmers said.
